name: mri_brain
description: Order a brain MRI to evaluate intracranial structures with superior soft-tissue contrast. Used for tumor characterization, white matter disease, epilepsy workup, and post-contrast evaluation.

sequences.description: Specific MRI protocol based on clinical question

clinical_indication.description: Reason for the exam (e.g., headache, seizure, suspected tumor, MS workup)

when_to_use: suspected brain tumor or metastatic disease
first unprovoked seizure — epilepsy protocol MRI
suspected multiple sclerosis or demyelinating disease
brain MRI with contrast for abscess or ring-enhancing lesion

examples.query: Patient with new-onset seizure, no prior history, normal neurologic exam

args.clinical_indication: first unprovoked seizure, structural epilepsy workup
